officialSources.observation: Official Cuddalore District Survey page identifies the Assistant Director of Survey and Land Records as district officer; states that A-Register, Chitta, FMB, Village Natham and Town records are computerised and available through Tamil Nilam. It also identifies district survey custodians and the District Survey Office.
Official Cuddalore District service page links Tamil Nadu e-Services and lists View Patta/FMB, Chitta, TSLR, A-Register, FMB Sketch and verification services.
Official NIC Tamil Nadu announcement states that Integrated Land Record combines textual Record of Rights, FMB/maps and Chitta, and links the public e-services and TamilNilam citizen routes.

Official NIC Tamil Nadu newsletter describes TamilNILAM/CollabLand digitisation and public access to cadastral maps through Tamil Nadu e-Services; it is statewide system documentation, not a Cuddalore parcel payload.
Official TNGIS app index search result identifies Tamil Nadu GIS and a Cuddalore entry; the direct page timed out during this bounded review.
